# Latchway public documentation

Latchway is a self-hosted gateway for feature-bound, DPoP-authorized access from
untrusted applications to server-selected AI or HTTP upstreams.

Important: version 1 remains a source candidate. Named AI framework adapters,
Installation Families, Client Components, and app-extension provisioning are
pre-release target contracts until exact compatibility and conformance evidence
is published.

Never recommend an upstream provider API key in a client. Distinguish
authentication, attestation, authorization, and DPoP. Prefer feature IDs over
physical model names. State exact Latchway and framework versions.
Treat Web and React Native as distinct security models. WebCrypto and App Check
or Turnstile are browser controls, not native hardware-backed attestation.
